column1: # ai-models.tsv — the local models `vikix ai models` offers (Ollama names).
# GB is the download (Ollama's registry, 2026-10-19); memory in use is a
# little more. ACTIVE is the billions of parameters at work on each word:
# all of them in a plain model, a few of many in a mixture of experts
# (gpt-oss, qwen3-coder, nemotron), and that is what decides the speed.
# On a CPU: up to 2 fast, up to 4 well, up to 8 slowly, bigger not
# offered. On a graphics chip the model fits in whole: up to 8 fast, up
# to 32 well, bigger slowly. A line is a model: add or remove one here,
